declaration: Written before running the five-band bipolar native-reference or time-refinement fixture in the finalized actual insulating-well field. Numerical tolerances are unchanged from the component gates.
required: Field standard/dense/domain reports pass and identify exactly current source and meshing-vendor hashes
Native NEURON independently constructs the five-band morphology and uses unchanged pinned AXNODE.mod
All stored observation timestamps match exactly with no interpolation, alignment, shift or rescaling
All active-site crossing counts match the native reference and time-refined run
Native reciprocal recording uses the exact physical field transfer vector and each model own outer membrane currents
Every intervention starts from the unmodified equilibrium for that dt; no intervention-specific reequilibration
Two consecutive dt-halving comparisons meet unchanged all-site RMS/timing/count criteria for every declared driven case
biologicalOutcomePolicy: Arm propagation, local-region dependence and soma-active necessity are measured outcomes, never pass criteria forced to favor an implant. A 0 mV crossing may be passive under strong drive. Lack of soma necessity is reported explicitly. Only ordered true distal-node events enter the protocol propagation classifier.
failurePolicy: Retain every failed run and all report/source hashes. A failed numerical gate withholds authority; no threshold change, time manipulation, voltage clipping or hidden parameter tuning is permitted.
